notes_for_editor: Single source: the FFLOS register entry. The californialookouts page for Potato Hill carries only an index line, so it is not cited. Two WebSearch calls found nothing about this lookout; the Potato Hill trail listings (try-ranger, trailforks) are not tied to this site and were left out. The register gives the tower height as '20 enclosed' with no unit, so no height is recorded. No photo URLs were captured, only the caption and credit. The story has no staffing, fire or access detail because no source gives any.
